THE RESEARCH TEAM'S THESIS PILLARS

Secular growth tailwinds trump short-term cyclicality in this trillion dollar market

Chips are the building blocks for the digital economy. They are pervasive, powering everything from smartphones and computers to datacenters, cars and medical devices. Global semiconductor sales have grown mid-single-digits annually for decades to $800bn in 2025, expected to top $1tn this year. Wafer fabrication equipment sales (including lithography machines) have grown high-single-digits annually since the late 1980s, with acceleration in recent years (5-year CAGR is 15.8%). WFE is high-teens as a percent of global semi sales (and growing), and lithography represents 25-30% of total WFE spend (and growing).

Source: ASML research pack 5_5_2026
